title: Treasury TIC annual survey of U.S. portfolio holdings of foreign securities (SHCA, end-December 2025) — final results, 4:00 p.m. ET
source: TSY: home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sb0618 (Treasury press release 'Preliminary Annual Report on U.S. Portfolio Holdings of Foreign Securities at Year-End 2025', dated 2026-08-31, fetched direct 2026-10-16, HTTP 200), which states verbatim: 'The final survey report, which will include additional detail as well as possible revisions to the data, will be released on October 30, 2026.' Two further Treasury primaries agree, each fetched direct the same day: the release-dates table at home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data (HTTP 200; October row '16' and '30 - final', under the header 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time') and the preliminary data page at ticdata.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/tic/Documents/shcprelim.html (HTTP 200; 'These are Preliminary data, released on August 31, 2026. This page and data expire on October 30, 2026.'). Mechanical corroboration: 2026-10-30 is a Friday and the last business day of October (the 31st is a Saturday), the same last-business-day convention the final landed on in 2023-10-31, 2024-10-31 and 2025's scheduled 10-31. Promoted estimate -> confirmed by this event's own initial research on the sibling standard (one Treasury primary plus independent corroboration); 'confirmed' describes THE PUBLISHED SCHEDULE only — the release-dates page carries the standing notice that a date 'will be revised after offices reopen' if Washington D.C. offices are closed, and the 2025 final did slip from 10-31 to 2025-11-26. Checked 2026-10-16
notes: Canonical file written by this event's never-assessed initial research (2026-10-16) after reading the one proposal that created it (from-tic-monthly-2026-10-16, now shadowed). Final edition of the end-December 2025 survey of U.S. holdings of foreign securities (the outbound mirror of the SHL foreign-holdings-of-U.S.-securities survey already tracked as tic-annual-survey-*-2027). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds: 16:00 ET publication after the equity cash close, a reference date ten months stale at print, no macro-keyed house playbook, and a headline already public — the preliminary (2026-08-31) put the total at $19,277bn and Treasury's own revision history is a few billion either way. Measured by this session: the preliminary-to-final revision on the total was +0.19%, +0.03% and -0.07% for the last three survey years, and the largest country revision in the 2024 top 20 was $6bn. The date risk is the real content: the 2025 final slipped 26 days (scheduled 2025-10-31, released 2025-11-26). Nothing here licenses an entry.
